original_test_intent: Set one selected BMC System Info parameter through the in-band path and prove the intended encoded value was stored without changing unrelated identity fields.
original_method: Preserve raw 0x06 0x58 write intent, but require an approved selector/value and Table 22-16c payload, complete baseline, explicit approval, exact 0x59 readback and authorized restore.
manual_activity: Engineer chooses one non-production test value and approves encoding/rollback; operator verifies the target, independent recovery and point-of-action authorization before the single write.
required_inputs: Restore value and independent OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Do not expose credentials or inventory data.
Verify readback before any further write.
No automatic retry after timeout or uncertain completion.
agent_execution_scope: Statically validate selector/payload and capture complete baseline.
Issue one bounded protected in-band 0x58 write.
Read back with the verified 0x59 request and compare all fields.
Report evidence without assigning DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve selector, value, encoding and expected persistence.
Approve exact readback form and rollback.
Own unrelated drift, failed restore and final verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct not to run placeholders, but it should retain the defined 0x58 function and require a controlled state-changing package rather than call it wholly unspecified.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a pinned encoder/state machine for one approved 0x58 payload, then the firmware-verified 0x59 request; never copy the source's readback bytes without schema validation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Selectors, raw commands, Table reference and 10/5-minute values remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Read the complete baseline, validate one payload and Set In Progress sequence, obtain confirmation, write once, decode exact readback, compare unrelated fields and restore the approved baseline when required.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: BMC firmware supporting System Info Parameter Set/Get.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds selection, protected execution, complete baseline, rollback and exact readback while preserving the write objective.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction to read-only; actual write/readback remains required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A malformed write can corrupt inventory identity and affect downstream reporting across reboot.

project_override_considerations: Another approved API is equivalent only if it writes the same parameter with auditable encoding, readback, persistence and rollback; read-only evidence cannot claim write coverage.
expected_evidence: Approval, target/firmware/interface and full redacted baseline
Selected parameter, exact encoded payload and Set In Progress sequence
Set completion plus exact read request/response
Decoded target value and unchanged unrelated fields

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source gives a broad placeholder write but no selected value/encoding/rollback, and its 0x59 readback includes an unexplained leading 0x00 before the selector; raw command success cannot establish correct storage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Selector/value, package, schema and rollback are Project execution inputs. The write purpose is clear and can proceed under approval once those inputs are supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps PARTIAL readiness but adds the required state-change classification and approval boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on one selector, protected write, full readback and rollback.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Converts operator-variable notes into explicit package and confirmation requirements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Uses Get as verification without allowing Get-only evidence to replace Set coverage.

review_improvement: Prevents placeholder identity writes, validates the questionable readback form and makes unrelated-field drift and rollback first-class acceptance evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: System Info fields are persistent management identity data. The source defines the protocol family but not a safe payload or restoration state, so this is not unattended automation. It remains executable after Project inputs and explicit confirmation, without downgrading the functional write to read-only.
